# Priyansh Khandal

> MCA Graduate Student, Certified SOC Analyst (CSA), and Blue Team Security Researcher specializing in SIEM Telemetry, Detection Engineering, Memory Forensics, and SecOps Automation.

Priyansh Khandal is an MCA graduate student and Certified SOC Analyst (CSA). His focus centers on blue team security operations, enterprise SIEM log correlation, Sigma rule authoring, live host memory forensics, and SecOps triage automation.

## Primary Surfaces
- [Home Page](https://khandal.tech): Overview, interactive SOC terminal workspace, competencies, certifications, and career contact desk.
- [Projects](https://khandal.tech/projects): Practical SOC labs, detection engineering tools, SIEM pipelines, and system configurations.
- [Researches](https://khandal.tech/researches): Technical writeups on vulnerability research, SIEM triage, and exploit mechanics.
- [Security Policy](https://khandal.tech/security): Coordinated vulnerability disclosure, safe harbor terms, and PGP credentials.
- [Sitemap](https://khandal.tech/sitemap-index.xml): XML sitemap listing all published routes.

## Core Specializations
- **SIEM & Log Telemetry:** Splunk Enterprise, Wazuh EDR, Elastic Security, Sysmon Event correlation, and Linux auditd log aggregation.
- **Detection Engineering:** Sigma rule development, YARA signatures, and MITRE ATT&CK adversary mapping.
- **Digital Forensics & Incident Response:** Volatility 3 memory dump analysis, Wireshark pcap traffic inspection, and artifact acquisition.
- **SecOps Scripting & Automation:** Python log enrichment bots, PowerShell triage scripts, and REST threat intelligence APIs.
